summary: Dickson County lookout about five miles north of Dickson; a 1953 survey describes a 40 ft pole tower. The state list marks it removed.

facts.design: Four-legged pole tower about 40 ft (12 m) high, with a wooden observation platform (1953 survey description)

notes_for_editor: Tower identity rests on the state list row (GC2564 removed) and the 1953 survey description of the same station. The brief's coordinates (36.1515, -87.4259) match the survey position (36 09 05.56 N, 087 25 33.49 W), so they are kept. The tnlandforms waypoint file (towers.gpx) gives different coordinates (36.2638, -87.5110); the waypoint file is not cited and is not used. No removal date, staffing, fire or current-access source was found. The 1953 directions in the datasheet are left out on purpose: they are old and the land may be private.
